q1: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2: SELECT DISTINCT(P1.EMAIL) AS EMAIL FROM PERSON P1 INNER JOIN PERSON P2 ON P1.EMAIL = P2.EMAIL AND P1.ID <> P2.ID

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 selects emails that appear more than once in the PERSON table, while Q2 identifies unique emails that have at least one duplicate in the table.
counterexample_dsp: A test database with at least two people sharing the same email address.
